statements.impact_statement: graphql-scalars 1.22.2 uses the bounded PhoneNumber pattern /^\+[1-9]\d{6,14}$/. The vulnerable nested pattern was introduced in 1.24.1. The advisory's affected-version metadata is broader than its technical analysis. Source: https://github.com/graphql-hive/graphql-scalars/blob/v1.22.2/src/scalars/PhoneNumber.ts . Advisory: https://github.com/graphql-hive/graphql-scalars/security/advisories/GHSA-x8rm-f576-gq67 . This statement applies only to version 1.22.2.
